phase: ROADMAP Stage 6 (second item): RBAC / workspaces / minimum-permission policy skeleton v1 (owner/admin/editor/reviewer/viewer roles, deterministic demo context, no auth provider)
summary: Added a deterministic, stdlib-only Stage 6 RBAC/workspace skeleton. build_access_context returns a demo current-user + workspace context whose allowed_actions come from an explicit role->actions matrix (owner/admin/editor/reviewer/viewer), defaulting to least-privilege viewer for unknown/missing roles. check_permission enforces known-action + role-permitted + workspace isolation (a resource in another workspace is denied). validate_access_policy checks the role, workspace id, and that any allowed_actions list matches the role's canonical matrix. New HTTP endpoints GET /api/access/context (with optional ?role= preview), POST /api/access/validate, and POST /api/access/check. A front-end 设置 panel section shows role/workspace/allowed-actions with an explicit no-login boundary. No auth provider, no password/session, no persistence, no network, no secret/.env read.
implemented: backend/server.py: added RBAC_ROLES, RBAC_ACTIONS, RBAC_PERMISSIONS matrix, RBAC_DEFAULT_ROLE (viewer).
backend/server.py: added build_access_context(user=None, workspace=None) (method=access_context_v1, auth=none, is_demo=true; unknown role -> viewer; allowed_actions from the matrix).

backend/server.py: added check_permission(context, action, resource=None) returning {allowed, reason, action, role, workspace_id}; reasons include unknown_action, unknown_role, workspace_mismatch, role_not_permitted, granted, invalid_context.

backend/server.py: added validate_access_policy(policy_or_context) returning {passed, errors, warnings, role, workspace_id}; validates role, workspace id, and allowed_actions consistency with the canonical matrix.
backend/server.py: Handler.do_GET serves GET /api/access/context (optional ?role= demo preview); do_POST serves POST /api/access/validate (422 on invalid) and POST /api/access/check.
frontend/index.html: added an access section in the 设置 panel with #accessRole selector, #applyRoleBtn, #accessStatus, #accessActions and an explicit no-login boundary note.
frontend/app.js: added loadAccessContext()/renderAccessContext() wired to /api/access/context, and a role-preview button; called from init().

tests/test_rbac_workspaces.py: 24 tests (context defaults/least-privilege, per-role permission checks, workspace isolation, invalid role/action denial, policy validation incl. tampered allowed_actions, live HTTP context/validate/check, and frontend token assertions).
tools/run_quality_gates.py: py-compile gate now includes tests/test_rbac_workspaces.py.
README.md and docs/ROADMAP.md document the v1 boundary; only the ROADMAP '多用户角色、项目空间、最小权限' item is marked done (encryption/backup/audit-log/provider-risk/SBOM untouched).
not_implemented: No authentication provider, password, session, or login flow; the current user is a deterministic demo identity.
No persistence DB for users/workspaces/roles; context is request-local.
No encryption/backup/recovery, audit logging, provider data-flow risk grading, or SBOM/dependency-locking (later Stage 6 items).
No network, no secret or .env read.

risks: This is a policy skeleton, not enforcement: existing endpoints (generate/export/library/config) are NOT yet gated by check_permission, so the matrix is advisory until wired into each handler. It must not be mistaken for real access control.
The current user is a caller-supplied demo identity with no authentication; anyone can request any role via the demo context, which is intentional for v1 but unsafe for production.
Workspace isolation is enforced only when a resource explicitly carries a workspace_id; resources without one are not workspace-scoped.
Role->action matrix is explicit with no inheritance; adding an action requires updating each role deliberately (auditable but manual).
